assay: bulk total RNA-seq (Ribo-Zero), left tibia, Illumina NovaSeq 6000 (S2.7.p1)
sample_inclusion: 3 left tibias per group sequenced out of 6 rats per group (S2.7.p1); 9 samples total
primary_estimand: Effect of 12 weeks of ladder-climbing resistance exercise on tibia gene expression in ovariectomized rats: RE/Ovx vs NE/Ovx (S3.4.p2, S4.p3)
planned_contrasts: RE/Ovx vs NE/Ovx (S3.4.p2; paper: 4423 DEGs, 2227 up / 2196 down) - exercise effect, primary
NE/Ovx vs Sham (S3.4.p2; paper: 6697 DEGs, 4040 up / 2657 down) - ovariectomy model effect, secondary (not an exercise contrast)
repeated_measure_unit: none; one tibia per independent rat
paper_method: DESeq2 on RNA-seq counts (S2.8.p1); exact design (all 9 samples vs per-pair subset) not stated
paper_results: DEG counts S3.4.p2; 401/213 OP-related DEGs after DisGeNET/OMIM intersection (S3.4.p3); RT-qPCR genes Acp5, Fos, Fosb up in NE vs Sham and down in RE vs NE, Calcr opposite, Stat1 up in RE vs NE (S3.7.p1)
